name: kctofficial/grocery-restable
description: Instant REST API generator for your database (PostgREST / Supabase style) with a Grocery CRUD-like fluent API and a phpMyAdmin-style admin GUI. CodeIgniter 4 first. Inspired by Grocery CRUD. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Grocery CRUD / John Skoumbourdis.

suggest.codeigniter4/framework: Required to use the CodeIgniter 4 integration (^4.5).
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Required to connect to MySQL / MariaDB databases.
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: Required to connect to PostgreSQL databases.
